output.notes: Described GPT-3 (175B, the model the paper calls GPT-3) as primary; all 8 sizes from Table 2.1 are listed. d_ff is derived from the stated rule d_ff = 4*d_model, so the numbers do not appear verbatim in the paper. The 13B row gives d_model 5140; it is reported as written, although 5140 is not divisible by 40 heads (40 x 128 = 5120), so it is likely a typo. The paper explicitly inherits the GPT-2 architecture. Norm type, learned positions, GELU (tanh form), biases, weight tying and the final layernorm are filled from GPT-2 as inherited values; the vocabulary of 50257 is inherited via the reused GPT-2 BPE tokenizer. n_kv_heads, layernorm eps, sparse band width and the dense/sparse alternation schedule are not stated, so the attention window is not_stated. The MoE quote implies but does not literally say dense FFNs.
